WITH all_hgb AS (
  SELECT HGB FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(HGB) as overall_average FROM all_hgb
),
patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(HGB) as patient_avg
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
patient_avgs_above_overall AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.ID,
    pa.patient_avg,
    oa.overall_average
  FROM patient_avgs pa, overall_avg oa
  WHERE pa.patient_avg > oa.overall_average
),
kept_patients_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(patient_avg) as kept_mean
  FROM patient_avgs_above_overall
),
final_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    pao.ID,
    pao.patient_avg,
    pao.patient_avg - pao.overall_average as above_overall,
    pao.patient_avg - km.kept_mean as above_kept_mean
  FROM patient_avgs_above_overall pao, kept_patients_mean km
)
SELECT 
  ID,
  patient_avg,
  above_overall,
  above_kept_mean
FROM final_calc
ORDER BY above_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
